# The support you deserve from an ally you can trust.

Alliance is your guide to health care services that help you live your best life.

[ Get Started ][47]

## Healthcare doesn't have to be complicated.

Alliance is proud to offer a comprehensive list of services for every age and ability to simplify
the process of finding and coordinating the varying supports you need.

### CFSS Support

 Flexible, self-directed options to meet your needs.

[ Learn more ][48]

### Consultation Services

Helping you understand the new CFSS program.

[ Learn more ][49]

### Financial Management

Flexibility and control to customize your care.

[ Learn more ][50]

### 245D Licensed Support

Individualized support in your home and community.

[ Learn more ][51]

### Mental Health

A variety of support services and therapy to help you flourish.

[ Learn more ][52]

### Medical Supply

Find equipment and supplies tailored to your needs.

[ Learn more ][53]

### Home Health

Care for your everyday needs in the comfort of your home.

[ Learn more ][54]

## Alliance Health Care builds bridges between people and the services they need.

Healthcare options can be a confusing maze that keeps people from finding the services and supports
they need. We believe something as essential as healthcare shouldn’t be hard, which is why we bring
together a thorough knowledge of the healthcare system and comprehensive services to deliver
high-quality individualized care.

Person-Centered

We recognize the inherent worth of every human being. Therefore, we believe that quality healthcare
is each person’s right, no matter who they are or what support they need. We build options that
start with the kind of life each person wants to live, and tailor our service delivery to meet those
desires.

Accessibility

Removing barriers and providing equal access to healthcare is an essential mission of Alliance.  We
offer our comprehensive list of services in all communities and strive to support your needs, no
matter how complex or varied they might be. 

Competence

Alliance started when our owner needed support at home for her daughter with Down Syndrome.  Our
personal experience, coupled with over three decades in the healthcare industry, gives us a unique
combination of both empathy and expertise.  We keep your perspective in mind when working with you
to provide personalized services that make sense for your life. 

Advocacy

Alliance is involved in many community and state initiatives to develop best practices and advocate
for increased support to the aging, disability, and mental health communities.  We listen to our
clients' individual needs and preferences and connect them to available resources, services, and
supports.

Inclusion

"We're the same. We're different. That's what makes the world such fun." ~ Sesame Street

Alliance recognizes and honors the uniqueness of every individual. We foster a culture of
inclusivity by providing healthcare services and employment opportunities that respects the needs
and preferences of each person’s culture, class, age, ability, and socioeconomic background, without
discrimination. 

[ Get Started ][55]

## Let's keep things simple.

Alliance is your guide to finding the right care that works for you. 

When you partner with Alliance, we strive to handle all of your healthcare needs, no matter how
complex or varied they might be.

[ Get Started ][56]

[Have a question?][57]

Alliance offers CFSS, Consultation Services, Financial Management (FMS), Mental Health, 245D
Licensed Support, Medical Supply, and Home Health services throughout the state of Minnesota.

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

# We are Committed to Life

[More][106]
[

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][107]
[

### Excellence

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][108]
[

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

[nurse taking hand of woman]
][109]
[

### Think Beyond: Latest Evidence for Effective Therapies in CKD

Join experts at the Global Renal Nutrition Webinar on June 16, 2026. Explore ERA 2026 insights,
protein‑reduced diets, and targeted CKD nutrition.
[Global Kidney Nutrition Webinar Key Visual]
][110]
[

### Women Who Shaped Us

At Fresenius Kabi, colleagues worldwide share personal stories for International Women’s Day,
honoring the women who shaped their courage and purpose.
[Images of Fresenius Kabi employees being interviewed on international womens day.]
][111]
[

### Fresenius Kabi recognized as a Top Employer in 13 countries

Fresenius Kabi has been certified by Top Employers Institute as a Top Employer for 2026 in 13
countries and additionally two regions.
[Image showing the top employer 2026 seals of the 13 countries and 2 regions.]
][112]
[

### Four Colleagues, Four Scientific Journeys: Voices of Women in Science

Female scientists from Biopharma, MedTech, Nutrition and Pharma share their stories and advice,
showing how science careers impact patient care and innovation.
[Image of women in science.]
][113]
[

### Meet The Heroes Behind Patient Safety

Unseen heroes ensure patient safety through precision, care, and smart tech at Fresenius Kabi.
Discover how people make the difference.
[Several people in different job roles like production and lab workers depicted as heroes with capes
and gadgets.]
][114]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Change in the Executive Board: Anderson and Herfeld hand over to Sowada and Wallisch

The PHOENIX group announces a change in its Executive Board effective 1 February 2026. Steve
Anderson and Stefan Herfeld will step down from their roles as Executive Board Members at their own
request.

[ read more ][19]

# PHOENIX group adopts climate target

The company has set an official target to become CO2 -neutral in its own business operations by the
year 2030. We want to avoid and reduce our emissions by at least 30 per cent (Scope 1 + 2
emissions). PHOENIX thereby underlines its commitment to creating added value for society and the
environment beyond our mission in the healthcare sector.

[ read more ][20]

# PHOENIX group presents LEAN Award 2025 recognising outstanding projects

We introduced lean management in our organisation two years ago with the goal to achieve continuous
improvements and drive cultural change. 

[ read more ][21]

## Working at PHOENIX

We are a successful company with a Europe-wide presence – with the **down-to-earth
attitude** typically found in a family business. Our success is due to our highly committed
employees.

# Change in the Executive Board: Anderson and Herfeld hand over to Sowada and Wallisch

The PHOENIX group announces a change in its Executive Board effective 1 February 2026. Steve
Anderson and Stefan Herfeld will step down from their roles as Executive Board Members at their own
request.

[ read more ][19]

# PHOENIX group adopts climate target

The company has set an official target to become CO2 -neutral in its own business operations by the
year 2030. We want to avoid and reduce our emissions by at least 30 per cent (Scope 1 + 2
emissions). PHOENIX thereby underlines its commitment to creating added value for society and the
environment beyond our mission in the healthcare sector.

[ read more ][20]

# PHOENIX group presents LEAN Award 2025 recognising outstanding projects

We introduced lean management in our organisation two years ago with the goal to achieve continuous
improvements and drive cultural change. 

[ read more ][21]

## Working at PHOENIX

We are a successful company with a Europe-wide presence – with the **down-to-earth
attitude** typically found in a family business. Our success is due to our highly committed
employees. 

[ read more ][22][ Europe-wide job offers ][23]

# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

## Pipeline

AS OF APRIL 30, 2026
* 50 Compounds in development
* 40+ Disease areas being studied

Our pipeline targets areas where we can deliver transformative medicines — for patients who need
them most.

# Pharmaceutical Medicine Manufacturers – Cefa Cilinas

We, Cefa-Cilinas Biotics Pvt. Ltd., have established a strong reputation by manufacturing an
imminent range of pharmaceutical medicines. Our company is based in Aurangabad (Maharashtra, India),
and has gained loyalty of innumerable clients by adopting effective customer-based policies. Our
years of experience and deep understanding of the field has allowed us to serve customers according
to their needs. Formulated as per laid medical industry quality guidelines, our medicinal products
are widely known across continents for their accurate compositions and high effectiveness. Our
business unit pay special attention over quality of its pharmaceutical products and adopt stringent
quality checking process so that no error go unnoticed by the eyes.

[MORE ABOUT US ][222]

#### Vision

Company always focus to develop the smart and commercially viable technology with low pollution and
execute the prompt service to the customer with excellent quality of products. Company always focus
on the offer the superior quality products at very competitive price to the customers which is most
important factor to retain the customers for long time and maintain the strong Bussiness association

#### [Market Entry][32]

CODADA supports structured market entry into Asia, the Middle East, and Europe. We help you find the
right partners, navigate compliance, and manage local follow-up - ensuring faster access and
long-term success across FMCG, food, beverage, cosmetics, personal care, and retail sectors.

#### [Market & Trade Representation][33]

Establishing a strong presence in local markets can be challenging. CODADA represents products,
brands, and companies in Asia and the Middle East on their behalf. Services include distributor
management, local promotions, and organizing trade events. This approach enhances visibility and
builds partnerships essential for sustainable growth.

#### [Distributor Management][34]

Working with the right distributors is critical for success. CODADA specializes in finding
distributors, building relationships, and managing performance. Support covers every stage, from
selection to long-term alignment with business goals. A well-managed distribution network ensures
efficient market coverage.

#### [Business Development][35]

Growth requires the right strategy and connections. Services focus on identifying new business
opportunities and building partnerships. Expertise in market entry and expansion ensures tailored
solutions for sustainable success. Support includes finding importers and distributors to strengthen
market presence.

#### [Import/Export Advisory][36]

Efficient import and export processes are essential for market entry. The team provides guidance on
regulations, licenses, certifications (e.g., Halal and FDA) and proper documentation. Every step is
designed to simplify trade operations. Businesses benefit from streamlined processes and full
compliance, ensuring success in new markets.

#### [Market Research, Insights & Reporting][37]

Understanding the market is key to growth. Services include analyzing trends, consumer behavior, and
competitor activities. The focus is on delivering insights that support better decisions and
long-term planning. Research helps identify opportunities and guides businesses in finding importers
and distributors for effective market entry.

## Why Us

CODADA supports FMCG, food, beverage, cosmetics, and personal care businesses with market entry and
distributor management.

With over 20 years of experience, we help companies achieve sustainable business growth.

Our team combines deep market knowledge across Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.

01

#### Comprehensive Services

Services focus on finding importers and distributors, ensuring successful market entry, and
establishing trade and market representation. Additional support includes import/export Advisory,
distributor management, and market research. Each solution is tailored to address specific business
needs, ensuring smooth entry and long-term growth. Detailed reporting and continuous support help
businesses adapt to competitive markets and thrive.


02

#### Proven Expertise

With over 20 years of experience in the FMCG, food, and beverage industry, CODADA provides unmatched
expertise. The team’s understanding of local cultures, regulations, and business practices ensures
challenges are overcome, and opportunities are maximized. This extensive experience allows CODADA to
anticipate market trends and adapt strategies proactively. Clients benefit from a hands-on approach
that combines global insights with local knowledge to drive measurable results.

03

#### Strategic Locations

With offices in Asia, Europe, and the Americas, CODADA provides access to key markets across Asia,
Europe, the Middle East, and the Americas. This global presence ensures timely support and tailored
strategies for each region. The multi-location advantage enables seamless market entry and sustained
growth for businesses worldwide. Proximity to key markets allows for quicker decision-making and
more effective market engagement. This structure ensures businesses remain competitive in dynamic
global markets.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Below you will find answers to common questions about our services and expertise.
If you require further information, please do not hesitate to [contact us][38].
* [What services does CODADA offer? ][39]
  
  CODADA offers a comprehensive suite of services, including market and trade representation, market
  research, distributor management, business development, and product and sales training. For more
  details, please visit our [services section][40].
* [Which markets does CODADA specialize in? ][41]
  
  We specialize in markets across South-East Asia, East Asia, and the Middle East.
  **•** Middle East: Bahrain, Iraq (North), Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia,
  United Arab Emirates (UAE)
  **•** South-East-Asia: Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore,
  Thailand, Vietnam
  **•** East-Asia: China, Hong Kong & Macau, Japan, Korea, Taiwan
* [What is the process for initiating a collaboration with CODADA? ][42]
  
  To initiate a collaboration with CODADA, please contact us via our contact form, email, or phone.
  Our team will engage with you to discuss your specific needs and tailor our services to meet your
  market expansion goals. Get in touch with us through our [contact page][43].
* [What makes CODADA different from other market expansion services? ][44]
  
  CODADA's extensive experience, strategic location, and comprehensive service offerings set us
  apart. Our deep understanding of local markets and personalized approach ensures that we provide
  effective solutions tailored to each client's unique needs. Learn more about us in the [about
  section][45].
* [Do you provide support for regulatory compliance? ][46]
  
  Yes, CODADA provides specialized advice on navigating regulatory requirements, including obtaining
  necessary licenses such as Halal and FDA, and handling documentation to ensure smooth and
  compliant transactions.
* [Does CODADA provide assistance with trade shows and exhibitions? ][47]
  
  Yes, CODADA provides comprehensive assistance with trade shows and exhibitions as part of our
  market and trade representation services. We organize and conduct these events to effectively
  promote your products and brands within the target markets.
* [What are the costs associated with your services? ][48]
  
  The costs associated with our services vary depending on the specific requirements and scope of
  each project. CODADA offers tailored solutions to meet your business objectives and market
  expansion needs. For a detailed quote, please contact us directly to discuss your requirements and
  receive a customized proposal. Reach out to us through our [contact form][49].
* [Who are your primary clients? ][50]
  
  Our primary clients are principal companies, including producers and brand owners in the FMCG,
  food & beverage and related industries, who seek to establish or enhance their trade and market
  presence in Asia, the Middle East, and Europe without the need to build and maintain their own
  physical presence. We specialize in helping businesses expand their reach and succeed in these
  dynamic markets by providing comprehensive consulting services, strategic insights, and
  on-the-ground representation.

## Contact

Ready to expand business in Asia & the Middle East?
Partner with CODADA and take the next step towards your business success.

Contact us today to discuss how CODADA can help you achieve your market expansion goals.

Below you will find answers to common questions about our services and expertise.
If you require further information, please do not hesitate to [contact us][38].
* [What services does CODADA offer? ][39]
  
  CODADA offers a comprehensive suite of services, including market and trade representation, market
  research, distributor management, business development, and product and sales training. For more
  details, please visit our [services section][40].
* [Which markets does CODADA specialize in? ][41]
  
  We specialize in markets across South-East Asia, East Asia, and the Middle East.
  **•** Middle East: Bahrain, Iraq (North), Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia,
  United Arab Emirates (UAE)
  **•** South-East-Asia: Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore,
  Thailand, Vietnam
  **•** East-Asia: China, Hong Kong & Macau, Japan, Korea, Taiwan
* [What is the process for initiating a collaboration with CODADA? ][42]
  
  To initiate a collaboration with CODADA, please contact us via our contact form, email, or phone.
  Our team will engage with you to discuss your specific needs and tailor our services to meet your
  market expansion goals. Get in touch with us through our [contact page][43].
* [What makes CODADA different from other market expansion services? ][44]
  
  CODADA's extensive experience, strategic location, and comprehensive service offerings set us
  apart. Our deep understanding of local markets and personalized approach ensures that we provide
  effective solutions tailored to each client's unique needs. Learn more about us in the [about
  section][45].
* [Do you provide support for regulatory compliance? ][46]
  
  Yes, CODADA provides specialized advice on navigating regulatory requirements, including obtaining
  necessary licenses such as Halal and FDA, and handling documentation to ensure smooth and
  compliant transactions.
* [Does CODADA provide assistance with trade shows and exhibitions? ][47]
  
  Yes, CODADA provides comprehensive assistance with trade shows and exhibitions as part of our
  market and trade representation services. We organize and conduct these events to effectively
  promote your products and brands within the target markets.
* [What are the costs associated with your services? ][48]
  
  The costs associated with our services vary depending on the specific requirements and scope of
  each project. CODADA offers tailored solutions to meet your business objectives and market
  expansion needs. For a detailed quote, please contact us directly to discuss your requirements and
  receive a customized proposal. Reach out to us through our [contact form][49].
* [Who are your primary clients? ][50]
  
  Our primary clients are principal companies, including producers and brand owners in the FMCG,
  food & beverage and related industries, who seek to establish or enhance their trade and market
  presence in Asia, the Middle East, and Europe without the need to build and maintain their own
  physical presence. We specialize in helping businesses expand their reach and succeed in these
  dynamic markets by providing comprehensive consulting services, strategic insights, and
  on-the-ground representation.

## Contact

Ready to expand business in Asia & the Middle East?
Partner with CODADA and take the next step towards your business success.

Contact us today to discuss how CODADA can help you achieve your market expansion goals.

## [Cold Chain Logistics][17]

Our reputable brand is backed by 20 years of experience and devoted to excellence, providing global
logistics services by air, sea, and road for industry leading brands.

We have a Global presence through carefully selected & fully compliant partners, with proven
expertise and rigorous quality standards.

Providing a tailor made end-to-end service – flexible to our customer needs – whilst being capable
of demonstrating a speed of response and efficiency.

We have a unique understanding of both the logistics challenges presented by extreme local
environments, combined with the global compliance and regulatory frameworks that underpin the
logistics industry. This is backed up by our vast operational experience in providing time and
temperature sensitive supply chain solutions, and our holistic range of industry-leading products
and services.

We offer a white glove service for clinical trials, or send outs, whether its Direct-to-Patient
(DTP) or Direct-from-Patient Services (DFP)!

[Learn More][18]

## [Domestic Transportation][19]

Fully integrated with our other supply chain services, our tailor-made domestic road freight
solution ensures operational excellence as well as a cost-effective option. Each of our thermal
mapped temperature-controlled vans are fitted with a sophisticated tracking tool, allowing you to
track your cargo’s progress in real-time!

[Learn More][20]

## [Passive Packaging Solutions][21]

Cold Chain Packing® is the exclusive Middle East distributor for Peli BioThermal.

Pharmaceutical companies — and other organizations looking to make significant cost and quality
improvements in their cold chains — are switching to Peli BioThermal for single-use and reusable
temperature-controlled packaging.

Our innovative, patented technologies and consultative services ensure product quality, mitigate
excursion rates, reduce packaging costs and drive Total Cost of Ownership across your entire supply
chain.

[Learn More][22]

## [Temperature Monitoring & Mapping][23]

Our Monitoring systems and solutions for rooms, equipment, & products in transit, cover Critical
Control Points in your supply chain, whilst helping you to record and manage temperature and
humidity levels in storage areas and within your shipment during transportation, covering those
Critical Control Points in your supply chain.

We measure, record, and manage data and – based upon stability criteria – assess these data for
release or alarm.

[Learn More][24]

## [Live Monitoring & Tracking Solutions][25]

We provide Global Visual Management to biopharma, high-value, high-theft risk cargoes and
progressive industries and manufacturers around the world who need to communicate with their assets
or manage their supply chain.

Whether the assets are stationary remote power stations or biological products being shipped around
the world we have a solution leveraging the intelligence of our technology, proprietary software
applications, and our people.

[Learn More][26]

## Dedicated Pharma Team

Our Pharma Team has the experience and expertise to provide support with ensuring your goods travel
safely through some of the harshest environments on earth.

## [Active ULD Management][27]

It is essential that you keep your Envirotainer containers iced and powered whilst waiting for
Customs clearance for inbound shipments, or connecting flights for on-forwarding to its final
destination.

We are the only Envirotainer Ground Services Award holder in the Middle East, supplying dry ice
replenishment and battery replacement at Riyadh and Jeddah.

[Learn More][28]

## [Cold Chain Consultancy][29]

We provide Cold Chain Management and Consultancy – including assistance with GDP / GMP Regulations –
to businesses requiring specialist Middle East logistics expertise.

With years of experience operating within the stringent regulations and harsh natural environment of
the Middle East, Cold Chain Packing® are uniquely positioned to provide the help you need to move
your business forward.

[Learn More][30]

## Regulatory Compliance

It is clear from the industry regulations enforced by the various health regulatory bodies, that the
distribution process is an extension of good manufacturing practices (GMP) – which all healthcare
companies are required to adhere to – and our main purpose is to ensure we support you throughout
the process:

> ‘’Storage of drug products under appropriate conditions of temperature, humidity, and light so
> that the identity, strength, quality, and purity of the drug products are not affected.’’

Food and Drug Association 21 CFR Part 211 Subpart H

We have a unique understanding of both the logistics challenges presented by extreme local
environments, combined with the global compliance and regulatory frameworks that underpin the
logistics industry. This is backed up by our vast operational experience in providing time and
temperature sensitive supply chain solutions, and our holistic range of industry-leading products
and services.

We offer a white glove service for clinical trials, or send outs, whether its Direct-to-Patient
(DTP) or Direct-from-Patient Services (DFP)!

[Learn More][18]

## [Domestic Transportation][19]

Fully integrated with our other supply chain services, our tailor-made domestic road freight
solution ensures operational excellence as well as a cost-effective option. Each of our thermal
mapped temperature-controlled vans are fitted with a sophisticated tracking tool, allowing you to
track your cargo’s progress in real-time!

[Learn More][20]

## [Passive Packaging Solutions][21]

Cold Chain Packing® is the exclusive Middle East distributor for Peli BioThermal.

Pharmaceutical companies — and other organizations looking to make significant cost and quality
improvements in their cold chains — are switching to Peli BioThermal for single-use and reusable
temperature-controlled packaging.

Our innovative, patented technologies and consultative services ensure product quality, mitigate
excursion rates, reduce packaging costs and drive Total Cost of Ownership across your entire supply
chain.

[Learn More][22]

## [Temperature Monitoring & Mapping][23]

Our Monitoring systems and solutions for rooms, equipment, & products in transit, cover Critical
Control Points in your supply chain, whilst helping you to record and manage temperature and
humidity levels in storage areas and within your shipment during transportation, covering those
Critical Control Points in your supply chain.

We measure, record, and manage data and – based upon stability criteria – assess these data for
release or alarm.

[Learn More][24]

## [Live Monitoring & Tracking Solutions][25]

We provide Global Visual Management to biopharma, high-value, high-theft risk cargoes and
progressive industries and manufacturers around the world who need to communicate with their assets
or manage their supply chain.

Whether the assets are stationary remote power stations or biological products being shipped around
the world we have a solution leveraging the intelligence of our technology, proprietary software
applications, and our people.

[Learn More][26]

## Dedicated Pharma Team

Our Pharma Team has the experience and expertise to provide support with ensuring your goods travel
safely through some of the harshest environments on earth.

## [Active ULD Management][27]

It is essential that you keep your Envirotainer containers iced and powered whilst waiting for
Customs clearance for inbound shipments, or connecting flights for on-forwarding to its final
destination.

We are the only Envirotainer Ground Services Award holder in the Middle East, supplying dry ice
replenishment and battery replacement at Riyadh and Jeddah.

[Learn More][28]

## [Cold Chain Consultancy][29]

We provide Cold Chain Management and Consultancy – including assistance with GDP / GMP Regulations –
to businesses requiring specialist Middle East logistics expertise.

With years of experience operating within the stringent regulations and harsh natural environment of
the Middle East, Cold Chain Packing® are uniquely positioned to provide the help you need to move
your business forward.

[Learn More][30]

## Regulatory Compliance

It is clear from the industry regulations enforced by the various health regulatory bodies, that the
distribution process is an extension of good manufacturing practices (GMP) – which all healthcare
companies are required to adhere to – and our main purpose is to ensure we support you throughout
the process:

> ‘’Storage of drug products under appropriate conditions of temperature, humidity, and light so
> that the identity, strength, quality, and purity of the drug products are not affected.’’

Food and Drug Association 21 CFR Part 211 Subpart H

dangerous or harmful. Instead, when used according to tested, safe and ethical guidelines, they are
our most powerful newest treatment of mental health conditions, from depression, PTSD, and OCD to
disordered eating and even addiction and chronic pain.

groundbreaking original research into drug harms and effects.

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

# Better health. Within reach. Every day.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our
communities.

[ Who we are ][82]
Play video
Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work.

# Better health. Within reach. Every day.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our

[ Who we are ][82]
Play video
Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically.

# Better health. Within reach. Every day.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our
communities.

[ Who we are ][82]
Play video
Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically.

Who we are

### [We’re Supporting Long-Term Recovery for Those Affected by OUD][51]

Indivior is a specialty pharmaceutical company singularly focused on delivering evidence-based
treatment and advancing understanding of opioid use disorder (OUD) as a chronic but treatable brain
disease. For more than 25 years, we have revolutionized the science of addiction medicine —
developing treatments that help people move toward long-term recovery with independence and dignity.

Our commitment is unwavering: to expand access to effective treatment, dismantle stigma, and empower
every person living with OUD to define their lives beyond the disease.

[ Explore our company ][52]

### 2.0 Million

Received Buprenorphine Medication Assisted Treatment (BMAT)¹

### 4.8 Million

People diagnosed with OUD in the U.S.²

### 7.8 Million

People misuse opioids in the U.S.²

How We Make a Difference

### [Powering Recovery, Renewing Hope][53]

We partner with scientists, communities, clinicians, policymakers, people living with OUD, and
caregivers to advance access to evidence-based treatment for OUD, dismantle stigma, and elevate the
lived experience of individuals in recovery. Together, we are advancing recovery for OUD — one life,
one family, and one community at a time.

Who we are

### [We’re Supporting Long-Term Recovery for Those Affected by OUD][51]

Indivior is a specialty pharmaceutical company singularly focused on delivering evidence-based
treatment and advancing understanding of opioid use disorder (OUD) as a chronic but treatable brain
disease. For more than 25 years, we have revolutionized the science of addiction medicine —
developing treatments that help people move toward long-term recovery with independence and dignity.

Our commitment is unwavering: to expand access to effective treatment, dismantle stigma, and empower
every person living with OUD to define their lives beyond the disease.

[ Explore our company ][52]

### 2.0 Million

Received Buprenorphine Medication Assisted Treatment (BMAT)¹

### 4.8 Million

People diagnosed with OUD in the U.S.²

### 7.8 Million

People misuse opioids in the U.S.²

How We Make a Difference

### [Powering Recovery, Renewing Hope][53]

We partner with scientists, communities, clinicians, policymakers, people living with OUD, and
caregivers to advance access to evidence-based treatment for OUD, dismantle stigma, and elevate the
lived experience of individuals in recovery. Together, we are advancing recovery for OUD — one life,
one family, and one community at a time. 

[ Explore our impact ][54]

### Explore how we are changing recovery

Our vision is that millions of people across the globe suffering from opioid use disorder have
access to evidence-based treatment to change lives.

### Our Science

areas, we keep the same molecules in stock month after month, and we are accountable for the chain
from manufacturer to hospital pharmacy.

## Welcome 

Interchemie werken ‘De Adelaar’ B.V. was founded on the 19th of January 1979 in Castenray, the
Netherlands. From its humble beginnings in The Netherlands, Interchemie is now supplying partners
worldwide with veterinary products including veterinary medicines, nutritional products and
disinfectants. We offer our products to careful selected distributors worldwide in Europe, Asia,
Africa, South America and the Middle-East. Interchemie produces according to GMP and GMP+
guidelines.

 

Interchemie operates three production facilities. With 12 production lines, namely:
injectables lines, oral liquids lines and water-soluble powders lines. Interchemie has attained this
high quality standard by continuously researching and developing new products. Because only by
improving our product line we can safeguard the health of animals in the future.

[

### Veterinary Medicines

][22]

Veterinary medicines fight diseases and cure various bacteriological infections. Veterinary
medicines are produced in accordance with GMP guidelines and consist of injectables, medicinal
water-soluble powders, medicinal oral liquids and miscellaneous dosage forms.

[

### Nutritionals

][23]

Nutritional products help to maintain animals' health, reinforce resistance and stimulate growth.
These products are rich of vitamins, minerals and amino acids. Nutritional products contribute to
the well-being of the animal. They are available in powder and oral form. Nutritional products are
produced in accordance with GMP+ guidelines.

[

### Disinfectants

][24]

Disinfectants contribute to a cleaner environment in livestock barns and farms.

[

### Premixes

][25]

Premixes for starters, growers and breeders.

[

### Milk Replacers

][26]

Milk replacers for fast growing young animals.

Pharmaceutical Medicines like Tablets, Capsules, Syrups, Ointment & Injections, etc., which is
applicable to cure various diseases.

With a 20 year history distributing and manufacturing drugs, peaking with the manufacturing of 1000
million tablets, 200 million capsules, 50 million oral liquid and 10 million of beta lactam dry
syrups, dry injections, we projected that the manufacturing of drugs would move to the country
resulting in intense commodity price and profit deterioration.

Thus, we formed our branded and technology division and have directed most of our R&D budget towards
new branded product development since then. There are number of pharmaceutical companies which do
not have their own manufacturing unit, so that companies are associated with us for third party
pharma manufacturing services.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

[Nous participons à de nombreux événements professionnels][38] chaque année. N’hésitez pas à nous
contacter pour y rencontrer nos équipes.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Access to Middle East Market & Beyond

We have distribution, and wholesaling operations in CC and CIS countries including Kuwait, UAE, Oman
and Afghanistan.

Our latest market expansion is in Turkey, in which we are working on establishing a medical device
and pharmaceutical distribution network. 

We help our brand partners with regulatory, regulated shipping, market access, clinical studies, and
distributions and sales for the Middle East market. 

 

We are always open to in-licensing and representative opportunities in the Middle East market. 



[Pipetting Samples and Test Tube_edited.jpg]
[Image by Arseny Togulev]

## Our Activities 

[heart.png]

### Medical Devices

We distribute and wholesale cardiovascular, anesthesia, cardiac care, Interventional
cardiac/radiology, Urology, and other operating room devices.

[pharmacy.png]

### Pharmaceuticals

We are currently in-licensing ecology and nerve system within our region. We are also manufacturing
and branding cosmetic, fertility, and men's health products using high quality ingredients. 

We are currently looking for a partner with a comprehensive line of generic products.

[logistics.png]

### Logistics & Shipment

Our location, in the port city of Dubai, our extensive network of medical-grade warehouses within
the region and our shipment volume have given us a competitive advantage in logistics and shipment
of hazardous drugs. 

## Our mission is to enhance the quality of patient care. We focus on quality and cost and
## time-effective solutions for medical professionals. Our mission defines our decision-making in
## our business practice to move us forward.
## MedPharm is working with various subsidiaries within different countries to create a corporate
## advantage for on-the-ground operations.

## About the Company

MedPharm General Trading L.L.C. is an international company based in Dubai. Every service that
MedPharm provides incorporates our entire knowledge and skills, since 1997. With our constantly
growing portfolio of effective medical solutions, MedPharm addresses the evolving needs of customers
in GCC and CIS countries including Kuwait, UAE, Oman and Afghanistan.

[Young Scientist]

[MCME-proud of the uae 2]
Proud of UAE
At Mediclinic Middle East we are #ProudOfUAE, The country’s progress is driven by the strength of
its people and their continued commitment to growth.
[Web Banner]
The Mediclinic App, Your Healthcare Companion
The all-new Mediclinic App brings together every aspect of your healthcare journey in one seamless
and secure platform. Designed around your needs, the health app combines trusted medical expertise
with smart digital convenience.
[Learn more…][97]
[Virtual_health-011]
Virtual Health Services
Virtual Health Service brings premium healthcare to your fingertips, built on the strength of a
trusted network of hospitals and clinics, and backed by personalised care coordination.
[Learn more…][98]
[MP-Web Banner]
Perimenopause and Menopause Package
Your journey through perimenopause and menopause deserves expert support. Our specialised package
offers a personalised plan tailored to your unique needs. Starting from just AED 650, the package
includes consultation, hormonal testing and more.
[Learn more...][99]
[MP-Web Banner]
Well Woman Gynaecology Package
Stay one step ahead with our comprehensive Well Woman Gynaecology Package - designed to support your
overall health, hormonal balance and gynaecological wellbeing. The package includes specialist
consultation, hormone testing, pap smear and more for AED 1,624 only.
[Learn more...][100]
[Health Check up M]
Corporate Health Checkup at Mediclinic
Boost employee health, engagement, and productivity with Mediclinic's customised health solutions.
[Learn more...][101]
[About Mediclinic Women m]
MEDICLINIC WOMAN – A NEW APPROACH TO WOMEN’S HEALTH
Explore Mediclinic's expert women's health services, providing comprehensive care from routine exams
to specialised support, all with personalised and compassionate attention.
[Learn more! ][102]
[Web Banner]
Home Care Services
Quality healthcare services in the comfort of your home
[Learn more...][103]

Minapharm has made its mission to provide patients in developing countries with easy access to
innovative and high-quality medicines. Minapharm’s expertise encompasses a wide range of medicines,
from small molecules with advanced galenic formulation to more complex bioengineered proteins.

Cairo, Egypt – January 4, 2026 – Minapharm, a leading pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical company
in the Middle East and Africa and a global provider of proprietary technologies, announces the

###### Minapharm Secures Funding from DEG Impulse to Localize Manufacturing of Women’s Health and
###### Family Planning Products in Egypt for Africa

Cairo, Egypt — December 18, 2025 — Minapharm Secures Funding from DEG Impulse to Localize
Manufacturing of Women’s Health and Family Planning Products in Egypt for Africa Cairo, Egypt —
December 18, 2025 — Minapharm Pharmaceuticals, a leading biopharmaceutical company in the Middle
East and Africa, is pleased to announce that it has secured funding from DEG Impulse gGmbH under the
develoPPP programme of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ).
* Press Release | 18/12/2025

###### IAVI, Minapharm, and ProBioGen Announce Memorandum of Understanding to Progress Clinical
###### Development, Manufacturing, Commercialization, and Access to Vaccines and Antibodies in
###### Africa

Cairo, Egypt and Berlin, Germany; New York, U.S. ̶October 10, 2025 ̶IAVI, a nonprofit scientific
research organization, based in New York, U.S.; Minapharm, the largest biosimilars manufacturer in
Africa, based in Cairo, Egypt; and ProBioGen, a recognized leader in contract development and
manufacturing, and a trusted technology provider based in Berlin, Germany today announced a
strategic partnership to advance the end-to-end development and manufacturing of priority vaccines
and biologics in Africa.

###### Family Planning Products in Egypt for Africa

Cairo, Egypt — December 18, 2025 — Minapharm Secures Funding from DEG Impulse to Localize
Manufacturing of Women’s Health and Family Planning Products in Egypt for Africa Cairo, Egypt —
December 18, 2025 — Minapharm Pharmaceuticals, a leading biopharmaceutical company in the Middle
East and Africa, is pleased to announce that it has secured funding from DEG Impulse gGmbH under the
develoPPP programme of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ).

research organization, based in New York, U.S.; Minapharm, the largest biosimilars manufacturer in
Africa, based in Cairo, Egypt; and ProBioGen, a recognized leader in contract development and
manufacturing, and a trusted technology provider based in Berlin, Germany today announced a
strategic partnership to advance the end-to-end development and manufacturing of priority vaccines

# Important Safety Information

**Do not share your Ozempic^{®} pen with other people, even if the needle has been changed. You may
give other people a serious infection or get a serious infection from them.**

## **What is the most important information I should know about Ozempic^{®}?**

**Ozempic^{®} may cause serious side effects, including:**
* **Possible thyroid tumors, including cancer.** Tell your health care provider if you get a lump or
  swelling in your neck, hoarseness, trouble swallowing, or shortness of breath. These may be
  symptoms of thyroid cancer. In studies with rodents, Ozempic^{®} and medicines that work like
  Ozempic^{®} caused thyroid tumors, including thyroid cancer. It is not known if Ozempic^{®} will
  cause thyroid tumors or a type of thyroid cancer called medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) in
  people

## **Do not use Ozempic^{®} if:**
* you or any of your family have ever had MTC, or if you have an endocrine system condition called
  Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2)
* you have had a serious allergic reaction to semaglutide or any of the ingredients in Ozempic^{®
  }injection or Ozempic^{® }tablets

## **Before using Ozempic^{®}, tell your health care provider if you have any other medical
## conditions, including if you:**
* have or have had problems with your pancreas or kidneys
* have a history of vision problems related to your diabetes
* have severe problems with your stomach, such as slowed emptying of your stomach (gastroparesis) or
  problems with digesting food
* are scheduled to have surgery or other procedures that use anesthesia or deep sleepiness (deep
  sedation)
* are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. It is not known if Ozempic^{®} will harm your unborn
  baby. You should stop using Ozempic^{®} 2 months before you plan to become pregnant
* are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed. Breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment with
  Ozempic^{®} tablets. It is not known if Ozempic^{® }when received through an injection passes into
  your breast milk

**Tell your health care provider about all the medicines you take,** including prescription and
over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, herbal supplements, and other medicines to treat diabetes,
including insulin or sulfonylureas.

## **What are the possible side effects of Ozempic^{®}?**

**Ozempic^{®} may cause serious side effects, including:**
* **inflammation of your pancreas (pancreatitis).** Stop using Ozempic^{®} and call your health care
  provider right away if you have severe pain in your stomach area (abdomen) that will not go away,
  with or without nausea or vomiting. Sometimes you may feel the pain from your abdomen to your back
* **changes in vision.** Tell your health care provider if you have changes in vision during
  treatment with Ozempic^{®}
* **low blood sugar (hypoglycemia).** Your risk for getting low blood sugar may be higher if you use
  Ozempic^{®} with another medicine that can cause low blood sugar, such as a sulfonylurea or
  insulin. **Signs and symptoms of low blood sugar may include:** dizziness or lightheadedness,
  blurred vision, anxiety, irritability or mood changes, sweating, slurred speech, hunger, confusion
  or drowsiness, shakiness, weakness, headache, fast heartbeat, and feeling jittery
* **dehydration leading to kidney problems.** Diarrhea, nausea, and vomiting may cause a loss of
  fluids (dehydration), which may cause kidney problems. It is important for you to drink fluids to
  help reduce your chance of dehydration. Tell your health care provider right away if you have
  nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea that does not go away
* **severe stomach problems.** Stomach problems, sometimes severe, have been reported in people who
  use Ozempic^{®}. Tell your health care provider if you have stomach problems that are severe or
  will not go away
* **serious allergic reactions.** Stop using Ozempic^{®} and get medical help right away if you have
  any symptoms of a serious allergic reaction, including swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or
  throat; problems breathing or swallowing; severe rash or itching; fainting or feeling dizzy; or
  very rapid heartbeat
* **gallbladder problems.** Gallbladder problems have happened in some people who take Ozempic^{®}.
  Tell your health care provider right away if you get symptoms which may include: pain in your
  upper stomach (abdomen), fever, yellowing of the skin or eyes (jaundice), or clay-colored stools

**Do not share your Ozempic^{®} pen with other people, even if the needle has been changed. You may
give other people a serious infection or get a serious infection from them.**

## **What is the most important information I should know about Ozempic^{®}?**

**Ozempic^{®} may cause serious side effects, including:**
* **Possible thyroid tumors, including cancer.** Tell your health care provider if you get a lump or
  swelling in your neck, hoarseness, trouble swallowing, or shortness of breath. These may be
  symptoms of thyroid cancer. In studies with rodents, Ozempic^{®} and medicines that work like
  Ozempic^{®} caused thyroid tumors, including thyroid cancer. It is not known if Ozempic^{®} will
  cause thyroid tumors or a type of thyroid cancer called medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) in
  people

## **Do not use Ozempic^{®} if:**
* you or any of your family have ever had MTC, or if you have an endocrine system condition called
  Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2)
* you have had a serious allergic reaction to semaglutide or any of the ingredients in Ozempic^{®
  }injection or Ozempic^{® }tablets

  problems with digesting food
* are scheduled to have surgery or other procedures that use anesthesia or deep sleepiness (deep
  sedation)
* are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. It is not known if Ozempic^{®} will harm your unborn
  baby. You should stop using Ozempic^{®} 2 months before you plan to become pregnant

## سياسة الخصوصية

في شركة فايزر، نحن ندرك أهمية حماية سرية البيانات ونلتزم باحترام خصوصية المعلومات التي يتم جمعها حول
زوارنا عبر الإنترنت. ونوضح أدناه كيفية الاحتفاظ بالمعلومات التي يُكشف عنها في هذا الموقع وفي ماذا
ستُستخدم وتفاصيل حول سياسة حماية البيانات الخاصة بنا. كما وضعنا معلومات حول استخدامنا لملفات تعريف
الارتباط.

نقوم بجمع معلومات التعريف الشخصية، مثل الأسماء والعناوين وأرقام الهواتف وعناوين البريد الإلكتروني، فقط
عندما تقوم بتقديمها طواعية عند التسجيل. قد تتعلق بعض المعلومات التي نجمعها منك بصحتك، ونحن نُقدر أنك
تعتبرها معلومات حساسة بشكل خاص. سنقوم بالطبع بمعالجة هذه المعلومات فقط وفقًا لهذه السياسة أو وفقًا لما
وافقت عليه. وبالتسجيل في أي موقع لشركة فايزر، فإنك توافق على أنه يجوز لنا استخدام المعلومات التي
قدمتها لنا بالطريقة التالية:

سيتم الاحتفاظ بياناتك في قاعدة بيانات بداخل الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية. تحتفظ شركة فايزر بمعلوماتك
الشخصية لتمكيننا من معالجة استفسارك أو شكواك أو الأمور الأخرى التي قد تطرحها وكذلك لتوثيق استجابتنا.
سوف تستخدم بياناتك لهذا الغرض ما لم يكن ذلك مطلوبًا للإجراءات القانونية. في حالة الإبلاغ عن آثار جانبية،
سيتم استخدام المعلومات المُقدمة لتلبية متطلباتنا التنظيمية المتعلقة بسلامة أدويتنا. قد يكون من الضروري
مشاركة معلوماتك الشخصية مع الشركات التابعة لشركة فايزر وشركاؤها والسلطات التنظيمية الموجودة بداخل
وخارج بلدك. وفقًا للقانون الواجب التطبيق، يكون لك الحق في الوصول إلى معلوماتك وتصحيحها. يرجى الاتصال
بنا لأي استفسار بخصوص استخدامنا لمعلوماتك الشخصية، على رقم هاتف شركة فايزر المحلي أو عبر البريد
الإلكتروني.

ستجمع شركة فايزر معلوماتك كمُراقب لقاعدة البيانات، ويمكن الوصول إلى التفاصيل الخاصة بك واستخدامها من
قِبل مجموعة شركات فايزر الأخرى. نظرًا لأن الشركة الأم لشركات فايزر(Pfizer Inc.) هي منظمة عالمية، فقد تُنقل
معلوماتك داخل أو خارج الدول التالية (الإمارات العربية المتحدة، عمان، قطر، الكويت، اليمن) و الأردن حيث
قد تكون قوانين الخصوصية أقل صرامة من الدول التالية (الإمارات العربية المتحدة، عمان، ، قطر، الكويت،
اليمن)، و الأردن ولكننا سنستخدم دائمًا تدابير أمنية تقنية مناسبة لحماية معلوماتك الشخصية وفقًا لنفس
المواصفات على النحو المُحدد في القانون المحلي ولضمان عدم وصول الأشخاص غير المصرح لهم إليها.

Yقد تستخدم فايزر معلوماتك لتزويدك بمنشورات مطبوعة أو عبر الأنترنت أو عبر الرسائل الهاتفية أو الرسائل
النصية القصيرة أو البريد الإلكتروني (ولكن فقط إذا وافقت على تلقي هذه الاتصالات منا كجزء من عملية
التسجيل لموقع معين). سوف تحتوي على معلومات مُفصلة كجزء من البرنامج المعني.

تحترم شركة فايزر سرية المعلومات الشخصية. ستتمكن فايزر والمنظمات التي تعمل مع فايزر في إدارة
المعلومات المذكورة أعلاه ومجموعة شركات فايزر من الوصول إلى معلوماتك. قد نستخدم معالجات تابعة لجهات
خارجية لإجراء الأبحاث أو معالجة المعلومات أو الحفاظ على المواقع أو المحتوى أو البرامج النائبة عنَّا،
ولكن لن يتم الكشف عن معلوماتك لأي جهات خارجية أخرى مثل، المؤسسات البريدية الخارجية. وفي حين أن ذلك من
غير المحتمل، قد يُطلب منَّا الكشف عن معلوماتك بأمر من المحكمة أو امتثالًا للمتطلبات القانونية أو
التنظيمية الأخرى. سنبذل الجهود المناسبة لإخطارك قبل قيامنا بذلك، ما لم يكن ممنوعًا علينا قانونيًا القيام
بذلك.

ستحتفظ شركة فايزر بمعلوماتك للفترة الزمنية التي يتم فيها تسجيلك في واحد أو أكثر من برامجنا المتعلقة
بالصحة.

يمكنك إلغاء الاشتراك في أي برنامج من برامج فايزر في أي وقت بالذهاب إلى صفحة الملف الشخصي واختيار "لا"
لقناة أو بالرجوع إلى مندوب مبيعات فايزر في منطقتك. نحن نهدف إلى التعامل مع طلبك (بما في ذلك إلغاء
اشتراكك في أي برنامج) عشر أيام عمل من استلامه.

## شروط الاستخدام

## سياسة الخصوصية

في شركة فايزر، نحن ندرك أهمية حماية سرية البيانات ونلتزم باحترام خصوصية المعلومات التي يتم جمعها حول
زوارنا عبر الإنترنت. ونوضح أدناه كيفية الاحتفاظ بالمعلومات التي يُكشف عنها في هذا الموقع وفي ماذا
ستُستخدم وتفاصيل حول سياسة حماية البيانات الخاصة بنا. كما وضعنا معلومات حول استخدامنا لملفات تعريف
الارتباط.

نقوم بجمع معلومات التعريف الشخصية، مثل الأسماء والعناوين وأرقام الهواتف وعناوين البريد الإلكتروني، فقط
عندما تقوم بتقديمها طواعية عند التسجيل. قد تتعلق بعض المعلومات التي نجمعها منك بصحتك، ونحن نُقدر أنك
تعتبرها معلومات حساسة بشكل خاص. سنقوم بالطبع بمعالجة هذه المعلومات فقط وفقًا لهذه السياسة أو وفقًا لما
وافقت عليه. وبالتسجيل في أي موقع لشركة فايزر، فإنك توافق على أنه يجوز لنا استخدام المعلومات التي
قدمتها لنا بالطريقة التالية:

سيتم الاحتفاظ بياناتك في قاعدة بيانات بداخل الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية. تحتفظ شركة فايزر بمعلوماتك
الشخصية لتمكيننا من معالجة استفسارك أو شكواك أو الأمور الأخرى التي قد تطرحها وكذلك لتوثيق استجابتنا.
سوف تستخدم بياناتك لهذا الغرض ما لم يكن ذلك مطلوبًا للإجراءات القانونية. في حالة الإبلاغ عن آثار جانبية،
سيتم استخدام المعلومات المُقدمة لتلبية متطلباتنا التنظيمية المتعلقة بسلامة أدويتنا. قد يكون من الضروري
مشاركة معلوماتك الشخصية مع الشركات التابعة لشركة فايزر وشركاؤها والسلطات التنظيمية الموجودة بداخل
وخارج بلدك. وفقًا للقانون الواجب التطبيق، يكون لك الحق في الوصول إلى معلوماتك وتصحيحها. يرجى الاتصال
بنا لأي استفسار بخصوص استخدامنا لمعلوماتك الشخصية، على رقم هاتف شركة فايزر المحلي أو عبر البريد
الإلكتروني.

ستجمع شركة فايزر معلوماتك كمُراقب لقاعدة البيانات، ويمكن الوصول إلى التفاصيل الخاصة بك واستخدامها من
قِبل مجموعة شركات فايزر الأخرى. نظرًا لأن الشركة الأم لشركات فايزر(Pfizer Inc.) هي منظمة عالمية، فقد تُنقل
معلوماتك داخل أو خارج الدول التالية (الإمارات العربية المتحدة، عمان، قطر، الكويت، اليمن) و الأردن حيث
قد تكون قوانين الخصوصية أقل صرامة من الدول التالية (الإمارات العربية المتحدة، عمان، ، قطر، الكويت،
اليمن)، و الأردن ولكننا سنستخدم دائمًا تدابير أمنية تقنية مناسبة لحماية معلوماتك الشخصية وفقًا لنفس
المواصفات على النحو المُحدد في القانون المحلي ولضمان عدم وصول الأشخاص غير المصرح لهم إليها.

Yقد تستخدم فايزر معلوماتك لتزويدك بمنشورات مطبوعة أو عبر الأنترنت أو عبر الرسائل الهاتفية أو الرسائل
النصية القصيرة أو البريد الإلكتروني (ولكن فقط إذا وافقت على تلقي هذه الاتصالات منا كجزء من عملية
التسجيل لموقع معين). سوف تحتوي على معلومات مُفصلة كجزء من البرنامج المعني.

تحترم شركة فايزر سرية المعلومات الشخصية. ستتمكن فايزر والمنظمات التي تعمل مع فايزر في إدارة
المعلومات المذكورة أعلاه ومجموعة شركات فايزر من الوصول إلى معلوماتك. قد نستخدم معالجات تابعة لجهات
خارجية لإجراء الأبحاث أو معالجة المعلومات أو الحفاظ على المواقع أو المحتوى أو البرامج النائبة عنَّا،
ولكن لن يتم الكشف عن معلوماتك لأي جهات خارجية أخرى مثل، المؤسسات البريدية الخارجية. وفي حين أن ذلك من
غير المحتمل، قد يُطلب منَّا الكشف عن معلوماتك بأمر من المحكمة أو امتثالًا للمتطلبات القانونية أو
التنظيمية الأخرى. سنبذل الجهود المناسبة لإخطارك قبل قيامنا بذلك، ما لم يكن ممنوعًا علينا قانونيًا القيام
بذلك.

ستحتفظ شركة فايزر بمعلوماتك للفترة الزمنية التي يتم فيها تسجيلك في واحد أو أكثر من برامجنا المتعلقة
بالصحة.

يمكنك إلغاء الاشتراك في أي برنامج من برامج فايزر في أي وقت بالذهاب إلى صفحة الملف الشخصي واختيار "لا"
لقناة أو بالرجوع إلى مندوب مبيعات فايزر في منطقتك. نحن نهدف إلى التعامل مع طلبك (بما في ذلك إلغاء
اشتراكك في أي برنامج) عشر أيام عمل من استلامه.
